endpoint services.list {
  route: GET "/services"
  output: [Service]
}

endpoint services.get {
  route: GET "/services/[id]"
  output: Service
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint services.create {
  route: POST "/services"
  input: { name: string(max 60), minutes: int(min 10, max 240), price: int(min 0, max 1000), about: string(max 280) }
  output: Service
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint services.update {
  route: PATCH "/services/[id]"
  input: { name: string(max 60), minutes: int(min 10, max 240), price: int(min 0, max 1000), about: string(max 280) } (all optional)
  output: Service
  errors: not_found, invalid_input
}

endpoint services.delete {
  route: DELETE "/services/[id]"
  errors: not_found, in_use
}

endpoint services.slots {
  route: GET "/services/[id]/slots"
  output: [Slot]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint slots.list {
  route: GET "/slots"
  output: [Slot]
}

endpoint slots.get {
  route: GET "/slots/[id]"
  output: Slot
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint slots.create {
  route: POST "/slots"
  input: { starts_at: datetime, service_id: Service.id }
  output: Slot
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint slots.delete {
  route: DELETE "/slots/[id]"
  errors: not_found, in_use
}

endpoint slots.bookings {
  route: GET "/slots/[id]/bookings"
  output: [Booking]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint clients.list {
  route: GET "/clients"
  output: [Client]
}

endpoint clients.get {
  route: GET "/clients/[id]"
  output: Client
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint clients.create {
  route: POST "/clients"
  input: { name: string(max 60), email: email, phone: string(max 30) }
  output: Client
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint clients.update {
  route: PATCH "/clients/[id]"
  input: { name: string(max 60), email: email, phone: string(max 30) } (all optional)
  output: Client
  errors: not_found, invalid_input
}

endpoint clients.delete {
  route: DELETE "/clients/[id]"
  errors: not_found, in_use
}

endpoint clients.bookings {
  route: GET "/clients/[id]/bookings"
  output: [Booking]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint bookings.list {
  route: GET "/bookings"
  output: [Booking]
}

endpoint bookings.get {
  route: GET "/bookings/[id]"
  output: Booking
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint bookings.delete {
  route: DELETE "/bookings/[id]"
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint open_slots {
  route: GET "/clients/[client]/open"
  input: { client: Client }
  output: [Slot]
  errors: not_found
  steps: find_open_slots
}

endpoint book {
  route: POST "/book"
  input: { client: Client, slot: Slot }
  output: Booking
  errors: invalid_input, taken, started
  steps: book_slot
}

endpoint bookings_of {
  route: GET "/clients/[client]/upcoming"
  input: { client: Client }
  output: [Booking]
  errors: not_found
  steps: find_bookings
}
